name: tiktok-easy
description: TikTok MCP with direct posting from the signed-in Chromium session, automatic full-CDP discovery or optional QR login.
long_description: Ask the agent to post with tiktok_post: on an accessible existing browser debugger, TikTok Easy verifies the signed-in account automatically on the first post. No login tool or copied cookies are needed. Browsers without a full debugger cannot be controlled by the tab-only companion; use tiktok_login explicitly for a dedicated QR login. Also includes scheduling, profile management and analytics.
